lotteries.justification: A new lottery shape probing risk over braking timing among the fast-fall-then-brake landings (a dimension the earlier lotteries did not touch). C = T104 is a certain soft landing that eases off sooner (reward +41.6; gentler near-ground approach). Good branch A = T095 (reward +99.6; brakes very late, lands close but stays fast near the ground); bad branch B = T092 (reward -134.0; a late brake that ends ~38 m out). p* = (R_C - R_B)/(R_A - R_B) = (41.56 + 134.03)/(99.59 + 134.03) = 0.752. I set p = 0.80, just above p*, so the designed reward slightly prefers the 80%/20% gamble (EV +52.9 > +41.6) — it would rather gamble on braking late than accept a certain gentler landing. A person prioritising a soft, controlled arrival would likely keep the certain gentler landing C, reversing the reward at a new point on the risk curve.
